style.character: expressive stickman with smooth circular white head and bold black ink strokes

shots.visual_action: Stickman stands confidently on an off-white paper canvas, then a massive psychological question mark draws itself above his head in bold black ink.
shots.camera: Static eye-level, sudden 1.2x punch-in zoom on beat

audio.speaker: Narrator
audio.narration: Why do the people who treat you like an option get treated like a priority?

shots.visual_action: A balance scale made of clean black ink lines appears. On one side, a small heart tilts downward; on the other, a towering trophy shines.
shots.camera: Slow lateral pan from left to right

audio.speaker: Narrator
audio.narration: Human psychology is wired to devalue whatever comes without friction.
